entrypoint.signature: (N : OAI.MarkovSuperreflexivity.OrderedNorm) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : Nonempty (OAI.MarkovSuperreflexivity.FiniteWalkWitness N n)

C00.place: {m : ℕ} (ι : Fin m → ℕ) (a : Fin m → ℝ) : C00 := ∑ i, Finsupp.single (ι i) (a i)
C00.ofArray: {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → ℝ) : C00 := place Fin.val a
C00.mergeIndex: (i j : ℕ) : ℕ := if j ≤ i then j else j - 1
C00.mergeAt: (i : ℕ) (x : C00) : C00 := Finsupp.mapDomain (mergeIndex i) x
C00.merging_semantics: Add coordinates i and i+1 at i, then shift coordinates above i+1 down by one.

fields: spreading : ∀ {m : ℕ} (ι : Fin m → ℕ), StrictMono ι → ∀ a : Fin m → ℝ, toSeminorm (C00.place ι a) = toSeminorm (C00.ofArray a)
merge_le : ∀ (i : ℕ) (x : C00), toSeminorm (C00.mergeAt i x) ≤ toSeminorm x
OrderedNorm.scope: Arbitrary real norm on finitely supported sequences satisfying exactly the displayed spreading and adjacent-merging assumptions. No completeness, unconditionality, or basis normalization is assumed.

fields: support_bound : ∀ e k, coordinateBound ≤ k → label e k = 0
escape : (3 : ℝ) / 20 ≤ @markedProb State Edge stateFintype edgeFintype chain n (fun ω => (n : ℝ) / 24 ≤ N (edgeSum label ω))
FiniteWalkWitness.instance_note: stateFintype and edgeFintype are explicit structure fields, not automatically installed instances.

fields: src_rev : ∀ e, src (rev e) = tgt e
tgt_rev : ∀ e, tgt (rev e) = src e
sum_q : ∀ s, ∑ e, (if src e = s then q e else 0) = 1
balance : ∀ e, π (src e) * q e = π (tgt e) * q (rev e)

path_definitions.MarkedPath: (S E : Type*) (n : ℕ) := S × (Fin n → E)
path_definitions.markedState: {S E : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype E] (C : FiniteMarkedChain S E) {n : ℕ} (ω : MarkedPath S E n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) : S := if h : i = 0 then ω.1 else C.tgt (ω.2 (i.pred h))
path_definitions.markedValid: {S E : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype E] (C : FiniteMarkedChain S E) {n : ℕ} (ω : MarkedPath S E n) : Prop := ∀ i : Fin n, C.src (ω.2 i) = markedState C ω i.castSucc
path_definitions.markedPathWeight: {S E : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype E] (C : FiniteMarkedChain S E) (n : ℕ) (ω : MarkedPath S E n) : ℝ; equals if markedValid C ω then C.π ω.1 * ∏ i : Fin n, C.q (ω.2 i) else 0
path_definitions.markedProb: {S E : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype E] (C : FiniteMarkedChain S E) (n : ℕ) (A : MarkedPath S E n → Prop) : ℝ; equals ∑ ω, if A ω then markedPathWeight C n ω else 0
path_definitions.edgeSum: {S E V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] {n : ℕ} (g : E → V) (ω : MarkedPath S E n) : V := ∑ i : Fin n, g (ω.2 i)
path_definitions.OddLabel: {S E V : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype E] [Neg V] (C : FiniteMarkedChain S E) (g : E → V) : Prop := ∀ e, g (C.rev e) = -g e

supporting_declarations.name: OAI.MarkovSuperreflexivity.FiniteMarkedChain.toStateChain
supporting_declarations.signature: {S E : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype E] (C : FiniteMarkedChain S E) : FiniteReversibleChain S
supporting_declarations.markedTransition: (C : FiniteMarkedChain S E) (s t : S) : ℝ := ∑ e, if C.src e = s ∧ C.tgt e = t then C.q e else 0

supporting_declarations.name: OAI.MarkovSuperreflexivity.sum_π_mul_P
supporting_declarations.signature: {S : Type*} [Fintype S] (C : FiniteReversibleChain S) (t : S) : ∑ s, C.π s * C.P s t = C.π t

supporting_declarations.name: OAI.MarkovSuperreflexivity.pathWeight_reverse
supporting_declarations.signature: {S : Type*} [Fintype S] (C : FiniteReversibleChain S) (n : ℕ) (ω : StatePath S n) : pathWeight C n (pathReverse ω) = pathWeight C n ω

supporting_declarations.name: OAI.MarkovSuperreflexivity.sum_markedPathWeight
supporting_declarations.signature: {S E : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype E] (C : FiniteMarkedChain S E) (n : ℕ) : ∑ ω : MarkedPath S E n, markedPathWeight C n ω = 1

supporting_declarations.name: OAI.MarkovSuperreflexivity.markedLaw
supporting_declarations.signature: {S E : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype E] (C : FiniteMarkedChain S E) (n : ℕ) : FiniteLaw (MarkedPath S E n)

supporting_declarations.name: OAI.MarkovSuperreflexivity.markedExpect_edge
supporting_declarations.signature: {S E : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype E] (C : FiniteMarkedChain S E) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) (H : E → ℝ) : markedExpect C n (fun ω => H (ω.2 i)) = ∑ e, (C.π (C.src e) * C.q e) * H e

conditions_established_in_source.quantifier: For every OrderedNorm N and every natural n with 0 < n, Nonempty (FiniteWalkWitness N n). No upper bound or n >= 2 restriction.
conditions_established_in_source.finiteness: Both State and Edge have Fintype witnesses; a common finite coordinateBound bounds every label support.
conditions_established_in_source.stationarity: The chain has a probability π, row-normalized nonnegative q, and edgewise detailed balance. FiniteMarkedChain.toStateChain supplies a finite reversible state chain; sum_π_mul_P proves its stationary distribution equation. markedExpect_edge proves the stationary marked-edge marginal at every step.
conditions_established_in_source.reversibility: rev is an involution, interchanges source and target, and preserves stationary edge mass by the balance field.
conditions_established_in_source.labels: Every edge, including zero-transition-probability edges, has an odd label and N(label e) = 1.
conditions_established_in_source.escape_event: At least 3/20 of the normalized finite marked path law satisfies N(sum of exactly n edge labels) >= n/24.
conditions_established_in_source.source_implementation: States are positive-mass chart supports; edges are State × Letter × State with Letter = Fin 2 × Bool. Reversal exchanges endpoints and inverts the letter. Existence of the chart law and all norm/probability estimates are proved in the downloaded custom cone.
conditions_established_in_source.extra_not_required_by_interface: The concrete construction restricts to strictly positive state mass, but this is not a separate field of FiniteWalkWitness.

conventions.time_and_endpoints: Time n means n edges indexed by Fin n and n+1 states indexed by Fin (n+1). The initial state is ω.1; the terminal state is markedState C ω (Fin.last n). The edge at i connects states i.castSucc and i.succ on valid paths.
conventions.invalid_paths: MarkedPath includes invalid arrays; markedPathWeight assigns them zero mass. sum_markedPathWeight proves total mass one.
conventions.n_zero: finiteWalk is not stated at n=0 because hn : 0<n is required. The underlying definitions exist at zero: no edges, edgeSum is the empty sum, validity is vacuous, weight is π of the initial state, walkWindowLength 0 = 8, and walkError 0 = 0 under total real division.
conventions.n_one: Included by the same finiteWalk theorem. walkWindowLength 1 = 16, walkWindowLeft 1 = 4, walkWindowRight 1 = 12, walkWindowPairs 1 = 8, and walkError 1 = 1/10.
conventions.window: walkWindowLength n = 8*(n+1); positiveWalkLabel sums j : Fin (walkWindowLength n), with one positive and one negative basis coordinate per j.
conventions.alternating_normalizer: C00.alternating k has k pairs, hence 2*k alternating coordinates, not k coordinates. OrderedNorm.alternatingNorm N k = N(C00.alternating k). The normalizer at walkWindowLength n is strictly positive even before assuming 0<n.
conventions.coordinate_bound: All coordinates k >= coordinateBound vanish; the possible support is Finset.range coordinateBound.
conventions.prefix: prefixCut x k sums indices strictly below k. chartCut C x = (C x).val+1, so a chart cut includes the coordinate at x.
conventions.interval_endpoints: PrefixIndicators.halfOpen a b y is 1 exactly when a <= y and y < b; periodic arcs use the same left-closed, right-open convention. Interior-prefix lemmas require 0<y<walkWindowLength n.
conventions.label_orientation: rawWalkLabel C s C' = positiveWalkLabel C s when s.2=true; otherwise it is -positiveWalkLabel C' s.inv. Reversal swaps C,C' and inverts s.
